title: Complimenting a Nice Hand After Showdown
summaryJa: ショーダウン後に対戦相手のプレイを褒める社交的な交換です。ポーカープレイヤーが良いハンドを見せた相手に友好的に接する方法を学べます。トーナメント環境での礼儀正しい英会話スキルが身につきます。
segments: You: That was a nice hand. Good call on the river.
Opponent: Thanks, man. I had a feeling you were bluffing.
You: You read me well. Nice catch with that flush draw.
Opponent: Yeah, I got lucky. Anyway, good luck with the rest of the tournament.
You: You too. Let's run good.
